# Call

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Call() with no timeout: blocks until the server replies.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
SvcResult Call(Handle port, uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | in | Port handle with PERM_SEND. |
| `xlen` | in | Request length in bytes, at most MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) (with PERM_TXFR) to copy to the server, or -1. |

## Returns

As CallTimeout().
